title: Bharti sells 10% of life insurance arm to undisclosed sovereign fund
body: Bharti Life Ventures has sold a 10% stake in Bharti AXA Life Insurance Company to an undisclosed West Asian sovereign wealth fund, two people aware of the matter said. The buyer's identity has not been disclosed because of confidentiality clauses in the share purchase agreement. Bharti Life Ventures held 51% of the insurer before the sale and is left with 41%.
